findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed no barrier to be used by staff when hand washing. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and hands were properly rewashed. Ensure a barrier is used when handling handwashing faucet to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed cheese to be cold holding at 55F. Discussed with PIC, cheese was placed in the back right corner of prep cooler directly next to hot holding. A lid was brought to cheese and was moved to a different location is prep cooler, cheese then tested at 41F. Ensure any TCS item being cold held is kept at or below 41F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Observed no thermometer to be present within walk in cooler. Discussed with PIC, thermometer was brought to walk in cooler. Ensure all coolers have a thermometer available.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed top of microwave and hot holding trays to have an accumulation of food debris present. Discussed with PIC, areas will be cleaned. Ensure non food contact surfaces are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents any buildup.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Observed shelving unit across from triple sink to be significantly rusted. Discussed with PIC, shelving unit will be replaced. Ensure staff is monitoring/replacing facility equipment as needed
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Observed caulking to be in a state of disrepair in the following areas:
1) The back triple sink caulking was observed to have black mold present.
2) The caulking at the back hand sink was observed coming apart from wall. Reseal. 

Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is replacing caulking as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Observed multiple boxes to be resting under a leaking Walk in Freezer unit. Discussed with PIC, a pan was placed on top of boxes to act as a barrier to the leak. Ensure food is protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, and holding of food. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the back metal panel of hood system to have an accumulation of grease below the baffles. Discussed with PIC. Ensure hood system is being cleaned at a frequency that prevents grease accumulation.  

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Observed the single basin sink across from triple sink to have a leak taking place at the drain line. Discussed with PIC. Ensure all plumbing  is in good repair. Ensure plumbing is repaired by a licensed plumber to prevent future leaking. 

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the walk in freezer unit to be leaking and have an accumulation of ice around the unit. Discussed with PIC. Ensure walk in freezer unit is repaired to prevent drip from occurring.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the seal on the floor in front of fryers to be degraded and accumulating food debris.  Discussed with PIC. Ensure flooring is smooth, non absorbent, and easily cleanable. Ensure flooring is repaired and being cleaned at a frequency that prevents food accumulation. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Observed the hood system light to not be in operation. Discussed with PIC. Ensure repairs are made so the light is able to be turned on and is up to the manufacturers recommended output of light. 

6-303.11: The light intensity shall be at least a certain lux and present in certain areas.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Observed multiple drain flies to be present near the back mop sink area. Discussed with PIC. Orkin was present during spot check, ensure facility has pest control treatment for drain flies before the follow-up date. A follow-up will take place on 6/25/24 to ensure pest eradication has taken place.

6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.
